description: One daily evidence-backed decision brief from the coding-agent projects monitored by The Git Reporter.

scope.coverageStatement: V0.2 reports one dated decision brief from direct public source evidence and keeps git motion as a secondary measurement layer. Community feedback metrics are absent until a reproducible feedback collector ships.

editorialRead.oneLineSummary: openclaw/openclaw leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: openclaw/openclaw — 114 commits today, 227.4 below its current daily pace, with 150 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
unslothai/unsloth — 10 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
Kilo-Org/kilocode — No same-day commit after 525 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Audit repository startup settings before trusting a Gemini CLI workspace
dailyInsight.insight: If you run Gemini CLI's A2A server against projects you did not author, audit one restricted-workspace start: verify that repository-defined MCP servers, policy paths, tool settings and telemetry are absent until an explicit trust decision is made.
dailyInsight.mechanism: Gemini CLI's merged public workspace-trust change gives explicit restricted-mode or untrusted environment signals precedence and, when the A2A server is untrusted, passes a filtered configuration view that omits repository-defined MCP servers, policies, admin policies, tools and telemetry.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: A checkout can describe more than source code when it configures an agent runtime. Separating the trust decision from the configuration that would start tools or route telemetry makes the authority boundary testable before an operator gives a project more access.

actions.audience: Maintainer or operator evaluating a Gemini CLI A2A workspace from an unfamiliar repository
actions.label: Trace one restricted startup configuration
actions.instruction: In a disposable environment, start the A2A path with an explicit restricted or untrusted workspace signal and a harmless repository settings fixture. Verify that MCP server, policy, admin-policy, tool and telemetry settings are not active before an explicit trust decision. Do not use the exercise as a claim that every Gemini CLI entry point or operating-system policy has been audited.
actions.effort: 20-40 minutes in a disposable test workspace

receipts.title: Enforce fail-closed workspace trust and filter MCP servers in restricted mode
receipts.supports: Shows the merged main-branch trust-resolution and A2A configuration change that filters repository-defined MCP servers, policy paths, admin-policy paths, tool settings and telemetry when the workspace is untrusted.

receipts.title: A2A workspace trust evaluation test
receipts.supports: Shows focused public tests for restricted environment signals and for the absence of the sensitive configuration families when the A2A loader receives an untrusted workspace.

confidence.basis: The merged commit, pull-request description and focused workspace-trust tests agree on the intended A2A configuration boundary. The evidence is source and test material, so the action remains an audit rather than a claim about a released build or every runtime path.

dailyInsight.limitation: The receipts do not establish that a released Gemini CLI build includes this change, that every command or extension startup route shares the filter, or that the named controls exhaust the configuration and security surface of a workspace.
dailyInsight.falsifier: Revise or withdraw the call if public source or regression tests show a restricted A2A workspace activating a repository-defined MCP server, policy, admin policy, tool setting or telemetry route before an explicit trust decision, or if documented behavior materially narrows the filter.
dailyInsight.watchNext: Watch for release documentation and cross-entry-point tests that specify restricted-mode behavior beyond the A2A loader, especially for extension discovery and new repository-controlled configuration families.
